id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_140.pack|cs_: ...Looks like we're safe now. I wondered for a while how this would turn out, but you saved us, old man.
Hee hee. Save your thanks for Alice, darling. She's our ship's mechanic, and handling the helm comes easy to her too!
Alice
Thanks? Shucks, no need. I just...
Alice
...Yikes! What in blazes is that?!
SQUEEEEEAL!!
Eeek! What is this monster squid?! Where did it come from?!
Heh heh heh... Regret defying me at the bottom of the sea!
Go, Krakengon! Batter that ship to your heart's content and send those rats to a watery grave!
Alice
Eeeek! It's coming this way! I don't want to die yet!
What's that sound...?
Is that a Gondolia merchant ship...? Could that be...!
Look... the giant squid is fleeing from the cannon fire.
Rotondo
Thank goodness, you're safe. That monster is the infamous Krakengon, which often ravages the seas around here.
Placido
Mister! It's me, Placido! My voice came back!
Rotondo
My son told me everything. So you are the ones who gave him back his voice.
Rotondo
I had been convinced his silence was the curse of the Luminary, a bringer of calamity...
Rotondo
But my son's account showed me it was all a misunderstanding. Please forgive my rudeness.
Placido
A while ago, outside town, I saw that man Jasper talking together with a monster.
Placido
I was so surprised I cried out, and Jasper caught me and used magic to ruin my throat...
Rotondo
The so-called Darkspawn saves people, while Heliodor, supposedly acting out of justice, is tied to monsters...
Rotondo
I don't know what it means, but you saved my son. Please, escape safely.
...{var:1}, can you hear me?!
I will catch you with my own hands one day! Spend the time until then in fear!
...Defying Heliodor will make business harder for you from now on, but I trust you'll manage somehow.
Look, {var:1} darling, a lovely sunrise. It's like it's celebrating our departure.
...By the way, Alice, have you learned anything about the merchant who bought the Rainbough?
Alice
Well, I heard the merchant headed for the Bandelfon region. It's from a reliable source, so it's sure to be right.
Sylvando... so you did care about the branch after all.
All right, everyone! We'll sail the seas of the world in search of the Rainbough! First stop: Bandelfon to the northeast!
